answer: A farm must thus either lie, which the signal graph proves on replay, or recruit 200 outsiders whose stake is exposed alongside its own. Because the declaration is checked against funding history rather than taken on trust, the lagoon registry records each claim and the forge audit publishes every slash. Attesters sign a declaration that they hold no common funding with the identity they attest, and a later finding of common funding voids the attestation and slashes 48% of the attester's bond. That is 29 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
